algarve.overview: The Algarve offers consistent beach breaks across its south and west coasts, making it a reliable destination for all levels. Beginners flock to the mellow waves of Praia do Amado and Arrifana year-round, while intermediates and experts find heavier winter swells at Tonel in Sagres. The water is cold enough for a 3/2 or 4/3 mm wetsuit, but with one coast facing south and another facing west, there is usually a spot sheltered from the wind.

months.11: Solid North Atlantic swells hit the west coast, bringing 5-8 ft faces to Tonel and Arrifana. Experts and intermediates thrive in these powerful conditions, while beginners can find smaller, sheltered waves on the south coast. Water is around 59 F, needing a 4/3 mm wetsuit.
months.12: Solid North Atlantic swells hit the west coast, bringing 5-8 ft faces to Tonel and Arrifana. Experts and intermediates thrive in these powerful conditions, while beginners can find smaller, sheltered waves on the south coast. Water is around 59 F, needing a 4/3 mm wetsuit.

months.3: Spring brings less frequent but still fun 3-5 ft swells to the Atlantic beach breaks. It remains a good time for intermediates before the summer flat spell.

months.11: Autumn swell season brings consistent 4-5 ft waves to the beach breaks. The reefs work for advanced surfers, and the water is still mild enough for a 3/2 mm wetsuit.
months.6: The Atlantic is mostly quiet, offering 1-2 ft waves perfect for surf schools and absolute beginners at El Palmar, but too small for experienced surfers. The water is warm enough for a 2 mm shorty or no wetsuit at all.

bahamas.overview: The Bahamas offers modest, uncrowded waves, anchored by Surfer's Beach near Gregory Town on Eleuthera. This beginner and intermediate reef break works best from November to April on winter swells. Expect warm water, but watch out for shallow coral and sea urchins. Bring your own board, as rentals are rare.

months.1: Winter swells bring 2-6 ft waves to the beginner and intermediate reef at Surfer's Beach. The water is around 75 F, so a thin shorty wetsuit is optional. Watch for shallow coral and sea urchins on the inside.

barbados.overview: Soup Bowl at Bathsheba is a heavy, world-renowned right-hand reef break that draws experts, while Freights Bay offers mellow, beginner-friendly waves. The prime season runs from October to March when North Atlantic swells hit the east and south coasts. The water is warm enough to surf without a wetsuit year-round, but watch out for shallow reefs and sea urchins.

months.12: Consistent North Atlantic swells keep conditions prime. Soup Bowl sees heavy 5-7 ft faces over its shallow reef for experts. Intermediates head to South Point, and beginners find perfect 2-4 ft peelers at Freights Bay.

months.1: Winter storms bring the most consistent swell to the Mediterranean coast. Barceloneta offers beginner-friendly beach breaks at 2-4 ft, while the reef at Sitges El Cementerio suits intermediates and experts. The water is about 55°F, requiring a 4/3 or 5/4 mm wetsuit.

months.9: Early autumn storms occasionally bring small swells back to the coast. Beginners might find 1-2 ft waves at Barceloneta on longboards. The water is still warm enough for a light spring suit or no wetsuit at all.
months.6: Summer brings flat conditions to the Mediterranean coast. Rideable waves are very rare, making it a poor time for surfing. The water is warm enough to surf without a wetsuit.

months.1: Winter swells bring 3-4 ft waves to the right-hand point at Long Caye, occasionally reaching 6-8 ft. The water is a warm 80 F, so no wetsuit is needed, but the coral rubble bottom requires caution. Suits intermediate to expert surfers.
months.2: Winter swells bring 3-4 ft waves to the right-hand point at Long Caye, occasionally reaching 6-8 ft. The water is a warm 80 F, so no wetsuit is needed, but the coral rubble bottom requires caution. Suits intermediate to expert surfers.

months.3: Swells ease but still reach the right-hand point at Long Caye on the better days, at about 2-4 ft. The water is a warm 80 F, so no wetsuit is needed, but the coral rubble bottom requires caution. Suits intermediate to expert surfers.
months.11: The first winter swells reach Glover's Reef, and the right-hand point at Long Caye starts working on the better days at 2-4 ft. The water is a warm 80 F; the coral rubble bottom requires caution. Suits intermediate to expert surfers.

months.4: Spring keeps easing the winter storms, with 3-5 ft swells at Lacanau and Carcans and more clean mornings for intermediate and advanced surfers. Water is about 55 F.
months.9: Atlantic groundswells return at 4-6 ft, met by crisp offshore morning winds that groom the sandbanks at Lacanau into hollow, powerful barrels for experienced riders. Water is still comfortable in a 3/2 mm wetsuit.
months.10: The prime surf season for experienced riders. Atlantic groundswells keep rolling in at 4-6 ft, with crisp offshore morning winds grooming the sandbanks at Lacanau into hollow, powerful barrels. Water is still comfortable in a 3/2 mm wetsuit.
